items.text: The Ley que regula la venta, distribución y consumo de bebidas alcohólicas del Estado de Tabasco (last reform Decree 139, Periódico Oficial Extraordinary 301 of 19 September 2025, which amended article 12) strictly forbids the sale and consumption of alcoholic drinks by minors, by people not in full possession of their mental faculties, by people who are clearly drunk or under psychotropic effects, by armed people, and by members of the army, navy and police (art. 31). Discotheques, cabarets, bars, bars with shows, cantinas and beer halls must post visible exterior signs banning entry and sale to minors and to people not in full possession of their mental faculties; every venue that sells alcohol must also post a visible sign that sale to those people is banned (art. 28 I and II). The law says menores de edad and does not itself define that age.

Article 11 sets statewide hours (several fractions last reformed on 1 February 2025). Grocery and similar shops: Monday to Saturday 11:00 to 23:00. Supermarkets and shopping centres, and mini-markets and convenience stores: every day 10:00 to 24:00. Discotheques: every day 18:00 to 02:00. Bars and bars with shows: every day 14:00 to 02:00. Restaurants, restaurant-bars (including those in hotels and motels) and their bars: every day 09:00 to 02:00. Beer halls and cantinas: Monday to Saturday 12:00 to 20:00. Hotels and motels for in-room service and servibars: every day 09:00 to 02:00. Show venues and dance halls: every day 09:00 to 02:00. Casinos, sports clubs and tourist or recreational developments: every day 10:00 to 02:00. Article 12 allows some of those licensees to apply for a limited extension. Alcohol may not be distributed, sold or consumed in the regulated venues on federal, state or municipal election days (art. 15). For public order or social interest, the Executive may change hours and dates, with advance public notice.

psychoactive-substances.notes: This is state law on licensed sale, distribution and consumption. The text read uses menores de edad and does not itself state 18 years. Article 12, paragraph 1, is the provision last reformed on 19 September 2025. A general ban on drinking in the street was not in the articles read for this record.
